XenotypeDef.label: nanite precursor
XenotypeDef.description: A synthetic humanoid whose biological presentation is supported by a reconstructive nanite body. Ordinary food supplies nanite feedstock, Nanite Reserve accelerates repair, and nearby same-faction synthetic minds can coordinate reconstruction through a local collective link. Electromagnetic disruption temporarily desynchronizes both body and collective connection.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Synthetic humanoid sustained and reconstructed by a food-fed nanite reserve.

XenotypeDef.label: human-form replicator
XenotypeDef.description: A synthetic human-form Replicator built from coordinated nanomachines. It can pass as a human at ordinary inspection while its food-fed Nanite Reserve powers accelerated reconstruction. Its lattice remains vulnerable to EMP, which also severs its local collective coordination. Infiltration, Neural Interface functions, pattern archives and block-Replicator controller authority remain separate systems rather than hidden properties of this xenotype.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Human-mimicking synthetic Replicator with reconstructive nanite physiology.
